Reverse pec deck 100 for 12 on all three. Overhead cable triceps 55 for 12 on all three. Rope pushdown 45 for 12 on both sets. Chest press, reverse pec deck and overhead triceps could have gone up, but they wait one session until these machines are confirmed.

No pain or soreness shows in any recent note. Conditioning: keep it easy today.
